findings.title: Tool result uses `output`, but the vToolResultPart validator requires `result`.
findings.body: `vToolResultPart` in `src/validators.ts` declares `result: v.any()` and has no `output` field. Saving a tool message with `output` will either fail validation or drop the human's response. Update the validator and serialization to the v5 `output` shape, or keep `result` here.

findings.title: File part uses `mediaType` but the vFilePart validator still requires `mimeType`.
findings.body: `src/validators.ts` still defines `vFilePart` with a required `mimeType: v.string()` and no `mediaType` field. Saving this message through `saveMessage` will therefore fail Convex argument validation. `vImagePart` and the tool-result image have the same mismatch for the autoSave example. Either update the validators to accept `mediaType`, or map `mediaType` to `mimeType` before saving.
